# Spanish 04 — B2 extended communication

Conceptual deck: `deck:es-MX:04`; display name: **Spanish 04 — B2 extended communication**. This stage contains exactly **1,200** original text cards, `es-04-0001`–`es-04-1200`, each with one primary hidden objective and one synchronized mapping below. Production uses educated contemporary central Mexican Spanish with context-appropriate tú, usted and ustedes. Regional quotation and marked-register recognition receive explicit attribution and coherent Mexican-compatible replies or paraphrases. Written phrasing support supplies no listening evidence.

[Execution #17](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/17), [roadmap #1](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/1), [Spanish plan #2, Stage 04](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/2#stage-04), and the [unchanged pinned Spanish guide](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/blob/e1d8239b7560f26b092cc7bb97c005738b34361f/languages/es.md) govern this ordinary editorial record. The verified accepted starting main is `23ea3b540c9e2fcf2428d222db49b79797b39770`, tree `9fd72ece7ba70bc34394886742ebad70539dca77`, containing accepted 01/600, 02/800 and 03/1,000. Accepted Spanish progress remains **3/7 stages, 2,400/7,600 cards** until ORCHESTRATOR accepts this stage; acceptance would bring the cumulative total to 3,600. Editorial `accepted` does not mean ORCHESTRATOR acceptance, exact vocabulary knowledge, examination readiness or proficiency outside these cards.

The following reconciles the guide's linguistic requirements separately from the numerical allocation. Ranges identify the actual principal work; each table row states the precise hidden unit and support rather than crediting an entire sentence as new learning.

| Guide §6.5 requirement | Actual reconciliation |
| --- | --- |
| Confident subjunctive use | A 0081–0180 extends present-mood complements, factive evaluation, influence, goals, optatives and precautions beyond 03. Earlier forms can remain visible; the new matrix, governed complement or discourse function is identified per row. |
| Past subjunctive | A 0001–0080 and relevant later A contrasts introduce imperfect/pluscuamperfect forms with simultaneous, anterior, prospective, modal and contrary-to-fact readings. Actual actors, reference times and realization are stated; subjunctive does not universally mean doubt or falsehood. |
| Conditional sentences | A 0041–0080 and 0161–0180 develop open, potential, counterfactual and mixed-time relations plus bounded conditional/concessive constructions. Protasis and consequence retain their own time and truth status. |
| Reporting across time frames | B 0181–0240 distinguishes anterior completion, future relative to a past report, current validity, explicit attribution and evidential limits. It rejects mechanical backshift and certainty inferred from a reporting verb. |
| Advanced relatives | B 0241–0340 supplies recoverable antecedents, governed prepositions, possession, object/adjunct roles, indefinite infinitival relatives, restrictive scope and contextual mood/alternative choices. |
| Clitic combinations | C 0341–0400 directly retrieves complete attached forms, new personal-object/recipient frames and fixed pronominal constructions. Fixed LAS is distinguished from an actual feminine transferred object. |
| Passive se | C 0401–0420 introduces new lexical actions and complements in inanimate patient constructions; passive SE and agreement often remain visible support inherited from 03. The hidden verb is not misreported as newly hiding SE or a plural ending. |
| Impersonal se | C 0421–0440 introduces personal direct-object frames and governed intransitives with unnamed human agents. Personal A, a governed resource complement and a passive subject are distinguished. |
| Accidental/affected-person se | C 0441–0470 develops physical/figurative changes with explicit owners, users, planners or experiencers. Affected datives, changing subjects, gradual deterioration and actual triggering events are distinguished; every such SE is not called reflexive. |
| Reciprocal se | C 0471–0480 supplies mutual collaboration, emotional response, support, toleration, courtship and reproach. Both directions are established. Recriminar's reproached content is distinct from the people receiving reciprocal reproach. |
| Reflexive/pronominal se | C 0481–0490 supplies self-portrait, deliberate posture, self-performed grooming and theatrical preparation. Actual actor/patient identity, purposeful pronominal movement and character portrayal receive their particular analyses. |
| Concession and qualification | D 0491–0560 develops factual/hypothetical concessions, degree/status, accepted costs, retained benefits and limited objections. It preserves claims without equating a concession with agreement on everything. |
| Stance and hedging | E 0631–0680 and 0721–0770 distinguish personal perspective, preliminary evidence, inference, graded commitment, negotiable terms and verified versus still-open content. |
| Logical connectors | D 0561–0630 develops topic, order, basis, cause/result, emphasis, alternatives and comparison. Arithmetic, comparison dimensions, causal support and necessary-versus-sufficient conditions remain explicit. |
| Reformulation | E 0681–0720 supplies actual source and restatement for equivalent wording, approximation, ambiguity, correction, distortion, generalization, source updates and emphasis. It preserves actor, beneficiary, quantity, condition, timeline and uncertainty. |
| Register differences | F 0771–0900 supplies actual relationship, authority, urgency, purpose and room to refuse; H 1116–1200 compares spoken interaction and attributed written genres. Longer wording is not inherently more polite. |
| Natural collocations | C's governed verbs, D–E's stance formulas, F's request/repair/accountability frames and G 0901–1070's household, social, work, cultural and reasoning families extend actual earlier senses. Source-specific acceptance and completion remain distinct. |
| Regional discourse markers | H 1071–1085 Spain, 1086–1100 Colombia and 1101–1115 River Plate contain new attributed targets beyond accepted 03; H 1116–1160 adds Mexican-compatible spoken functions. Shared usage is not exclusive to a named country, and regional recognition does not create productive voseo/vosotros drills. |

## Thirty batches: objectives and prerequisite basis

All 30 batches use consecutive groups of 40. Their concrete senses, complements, collocations, grammatical choices and pragmatic distinctions were enumerated before authoring. Each author receives the actual accepted hidden-unit inventory and relevant complete earlier cards; each separate editor additionally receives complete actual records for every referenced prerequisite. EXECUTOR reads all complete outputs, resolves findings, saves the synchronized rows and applies cheap changed-record/mapping and incremental duplicate checks. ## Primary-reference decisions and editorial boundaries

Unchanged accepted decisions are reused, including 02-0750's feminine personal direct-object **la**, and 03-0976's **preferís/decídmelo** followed by the intentionally introduced **Díganmelo** paraphrase. References support bounded usage decisions; all new situations and quotations are authored examples, not copied guide/reference sentences or fabricated real-world reports.

- [DPD si](https://www.rae.es/dpd/si), [NGLE 24.1](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/los-tiempos-del-subjuntivo-i-características-generales-el-presente-cante-y-el-pretérito-perfecto-compuesto-haya-cantado), [24.2](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/los-tiempos-del-subjuntivo-ii--el-pretérito-imperfecto-cantara-o-cantase-y-el-pretérito-pluscuamperfecto-hubiera-o-hubiese-cantado) and [24.8](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/la-concordancia-de-tiempos-ii-relaciones-de-anterioridad-posterioridad-y-simultaneidad-interpretaciones-de-doble-acceso) distinguish conditional/event relations, induced past subjunctive, restricted modal RA uses and continued-validity reporting. Selected task-valid alternatives are contextual decisions, not automatic RA/SE or mood lists.
- [NGLE 25.3](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/el-modo-en-las-subordinadas-sustantivas-i-contextos-básicos-de-selección-del-modo), [26.8](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/sujetos-expresos-y-sujetos-tácitos-ii-correferencia-de-sujetos), [26.4](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/los-infinitivos-verbales-su-interpretación-semántica-infinitivo-simple-e-infinitivo-compuesto) and [DPD lamentar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/lamentar) support shared-subject factual perfect-infinitive regret at 0110, distinct from conditional DE HABER at 0061. This resolved a concrete novelty gap through one targeted fresh editor, without repeating a completed batch audit.
- Selected complement decisions use [DPD optar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/optar), [bastar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/bastar), [contribuir](https://www.rae.es/dpd/contribuir), [disuadir](https://www.rae.es/dpd/disuadir), [persuadir](https://www.rae.es/dpd/persuadir), [asegurar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/asegurar), [urgir](https://www.rae.es/dpd/urgir), [instar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/instar), [convenir](https://www.rae.es/dpd/convenir), [discrepar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/discrepar), [jactar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/jactar) and [aludir](https://www.rae.es/dpd/aludir). Personal direct objects, requested-action complements, resource/goal prepositions and finite versus pronominal frames retain their actual distinctions. Less preferred or differently governed alternatives are not universally banned.
- [DPD cuyo](https://www.rae.es/dpd/cuyo), [NGLE 26.12](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/el-infinitivo-en-las-oraciones-de-relativo) and [25.11](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/el-modo-en-las-subordinadas-relativas-iii-inductores-modales) support possessed-noun agreement, governed relative roles, indefinite infinitival relatives and context-sensitive mood. Tonic free-relative QUIEN may carry an accent without becoming an interrogative; exact alternatives are adjudicated for their visible task.
- [DPD pronombres personales átonos](https://www.rae.es/dpd/pronombres%20personales%20%C3%A1tonos), [eximir](https://www.rae.es/dpd/eximir), [resarcir](https://www.rae.es/dpd/resarcir) and [corresponder](https://www.rae.es/dpd/corresponder), plus checked DLE [ingeniar](https://dle.rae.es/ingeniar), [arreglar](https://dle.rae.es/arreglar), [traer](https://dle.rae.es/traer), [haber](https://dle.rae.es/haber), [dar](https://dle.rae.es/dar), [jugar](https://dle.rae.es/jugar) and [ver](https://dle.rae.es/ver) locutions, distinguish fixed clitics, personal direct objects, recipients, affected datives and reciprocal frames. The selected resarcir frame does not ban its other object configuration. [DLE despostillar](https://dle.rae.es/despostillar) supports the Mexican-compatible edge-chipping variant; [DEM pasar](https://dem.colmex.mx/ver/pasar) supports Mexican PASÁRSELA with a gerund. The complete idiom at 0398 has lemma **vérselas y deseárselas**.
- [NGLE 47.13](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/tiempo-y-modo-en-las-oraciones-concesivas) and [47.15](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/construcciones-preposicionales-de-sentido-concesivo-ii-los-tipos-por-fuerte-que-sea-y-con-el-talento-que-tiene-sus-variantes-sintácticas) distinguish factual/background and hypothetical concession, quantity/degree, minimal thresholds and lexicalized nonquantitative POR MÁS QUE. [NGLE 25.13](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/elección-del-modo-con-las-conjunciones-subordinantes) permits both moods after DE AHÍ QUE and distinguishes purpose from asserted result. These are contextual choices, not a universal subjunctive-only rule.
- [DPD atenuante](https://www.rae.es/dpd/atenuante), [agravante](https://www.rae.es/dpd/agravante), [haber](https://www.rae.es/dpd/haber), [conque](https://www.rae.es/dpd/conque) and [tanto](https://www.rae.es/dpd/tanto) support ordinary nominal gender, HABIDA CUENTA DE, consecutive CONQUE and coordination. EN CUANTO+noun role is used instead of the criticized EN TANTO QUE+noun calque; valid temporal EN TANTO remains available. Regional plural HABIDAS CUENTAS is not categorically banned.
- [DPD transigir](https://www.rae.es/dpd/transigir), [rehusar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/rehusar), [quedar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/quedar), [DLE desambiguar](https://dle.rae.es/desambiguar), [tanteo](https://dle.rae.es/tanteo) and [firme](https://dle.rae.es/firme) support EN/CON government, American REHUSARSE A alongside transitive REHUSAR, finite agreement EN QUE, linguistic disambiguation, approximation without weighing/measuring and definitive commercial arrangements. [DLE faltar](https://dle.rae.es/faltar) supports the explicitly favorable NO FALTABA MÁS response alongside its separate rejection function.
- [DLE pícnic](https://dle.rae.es/pícnic) verifies the accented adapted headword. The final-pass spelling correction is synchronized across affected new Spanish sentences and vocabulary headwords, with English picnic retained in translations.
- [DEM limón](https://dem.colmex.mx/ver/limón) describes the acidic citrus fruit with green or yellow skin. The food examples leave its exact English variety open as lemon or lime; their situations do not add an unstated meal time or home setting.
- Spain targets use checked DLE senses of [guay](https://dle.rae.es/guay), [molar](https://dle.rae.es/molar), [flipar](https://dle.rae.es/flipar), [menudo](https://dle.rae.es/menudo), [loro](https://dle.rae.es/loro), [chapuza](https://dle.rae.es/chapuza), [apañar](https://dle.rae.es/apañar), [escaquear](https://dle.rae.es/escaquear), [chaval](https://dle.rae.es/chaval), [pasta](https://dle.rae.es/pasta), [chollo](https://dle.rae.es/chollo), [cutre](https://dle.rae.es/cutre), [enhorabuena](https://dle.rae.es/enhorabuena) and [chulo](https://dle.rae.es/chulo). [USAL Stylus EN PLAN](https://stylus.usal.es/sugerencia/en-plan/) supplies the checked illustrative discourse use; DLE PLAN's attitude sense alone would not establish that function. Style advice is not converted into a grammar ban.
- Colombia uses checked [DA camellar](https://www.asale.org/damer/camellar), [amañado](https://www.asale.org/damer/amañado), [berraco](https://www.asale.org/damer/berraco), [emberracar](https://www.asale.org/damer/emberracar), [dar](https://www.asale.org/damer/dar), [hacer](https://www.asale.org/damer/hacer), [quiubo](https://www.asale.org/damer/quiubo), [paila](https://www.asale.org/damer/paila), [vaina](https://www.asale.org/damer/vaina), [chuspa](https://www.asale.org/damer/chuspa), [esfero](https://www.asale.org/damer/esfero), [parar](https://www.asale.org/damer/parar), [mamar](https://www.asale.org/damer/mamar) and [vaca](https://www.asale.org/damer/vaca). PAILA selects the youthful adverb “very badly”; CHUSPA's shopping-bag sense is western Colombia/Cali. HÁGALE selects acceptance; MAMAR GALLO selects joking rather than false promises. VACA is the pooled-money noun; its whole carrier frame remains actual editorial work.
- River Plate uses checked [DA bancar](https://www.asale.org/damer/bancar), [toque](https://www.asale.org/damer/toque), [embole](https://www.asale.org/damer/embole), [quilombo](https://www.asale.org/damer/quilombo), [bondi](https://www.asale.org/damer/bondi), [pibe](https://www.asale.org/damer/pibe), [chamuyo](https://www.asale.org/damer/chamuyo), [macana](https://www.asale.org/damer/macana), [macanudo](https://www.asale.org/damer/macanudo), [copado](https://www.asale.org/damer/copado), [fiaca](https://www.asale.org/damer/fiaca), [morfar](https://www.asale.org/damer/morfar), DAR/HACER locutions and [DLE guita](https://dle.rae.es/guita). Argentine FIACA selects laziness, not Uruguay's separate hunger sense; MORFAR selects eating without inherently rapid action. HACER LA GAMBA selects Argentine help, not Chilean flattery. Error, disorder and persuasive patter are not automatically deliberate deceit or unrelated taboo senses.
- Mexican spoken decisions use [DA órale](https://www.asale.org/damer/¡órale!), [ándale](https://www.asale.org/damer/¡ándale!), [híjole](https://www.asale.org/damer/¡híjole!), [ajá](https://www.asale.org/damer/¡ajá!), [poco](https://www.asale.org/damer/poco), [modo](https://www.asale.org/damer/modo), [mandar](https://www.asale.org/damer/mandar), [latir](https://www.asale.org/damer/latir), [chance](https://www.asale.org/damer/chance), [chamba](https://www.asale.org/damer/chamba), [chambear](https://www.asale.org/damer/chambear), [volada](https://www.asale.org/damer/volada), [pilón](https://www.asale.org/damer/pilón), [chin](https://www.asale.org/damer/¡chin!), [DLE este](https://dle.rae.es/este), [cómo](https://dle.rae.es/cómo), [saber](https://dle.rae.es/saber), [decir](https://dle.rae.es/decir), [DEM bueno](https://dem.colmex.mx/ver/bueno), [onda](https://dem.colmex.mx/ver/onda), [veinte](https://dem.colmex.mx/ver/veinte), [cuadrar](https://dem.colmex.mx/ver/cuadrar) and [plano](https://dem.colmex.mx/ver/plano). AJÁ invites continuation; MANDE answers a call; CHANCE is masculine; uncertain A SABER differs from enumerative 0685. Source-defined uncertainty, preference, acknowledgment and firmness do not prove a fact or future compliance.
- Written decisions use [DPD ara](https://www.rae.es/dpd/ara), [aunar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/aunar), [inclusive](https://www.rae.es/dpd/inclusive), [DLE efecto](https://dle.rae.es/efecto), [tenor](https://dle.rae.es/tenor), [amén](https://dle.rae.es/amén), [máxime](https://dle.rae.es/máxime), [sazón](https://dle.rae.es/sazón), [postre](https://dle.rae.es/postre), [resulta](https://dle.rae.es/resulta), [expensas](https://dle.rae.es/expensas), [despecho](https://dle.rae.es/despecho) and [NGLE 46.6n/ñ/q](https://www.rae.es/gramática/sintaxis/las-causales-explicativas). EN ARAS DE benefits a value/interest; AUNADO requires its actual agreement/referent; INCLUSIVE is invariable and may overlap INCLUSO. TODA VEZ QUE and VISTO QUE are explanatory causals. The final maps identify actual genres rather than declaring neutral written wording recognition-only.

Failed reads never count as verification. Optional unverified targets were replaced before authoring where needed; no linguistic prohibition is inferred from one absent entry. The successful NGLE causal read supplies the TODA VEZ QUE decision after unsuccessful DLE/DPD finds and an oversized PDF fetch. Existing verified facts are reused without reopening unchanged investigations.

## Cross-cutting review

Each situation supplies its own actors, roles, beneficiaries, antecedents, time anchors, evidence and comparison; English support stays within that Spanish information. A name or familiar address does not establish friendship, occupation or family-side relationships. A surface width comparison does not establish whole-object fit. A proposed agreement, accepted promise, performed action and subjective evaluation remain distinct.

The stage includes ordinary household narratives, food and craft work, social relationships, travel, culture, short reports, proposals, negotiation, source comparison and service responses. G and H extend that breadth without claiming full C1/C2 synthesis, specialist competence or literary mastery. Regional quotation agreement is coherent; no unmarked productive voseo/vosotros is assigned. P/R decisions are justified per row, with no copied stage03 quota. Pronunciation-aware written phrasing is kept separate from actual audio/listening work.
